Top performers will be eligible for a range of rewards, including THE Tokens, theNFTs, exclusive THENA IDs, and more to be announced. On each chapter, participants will have a chance to earn that particular chapter's rewards based on the raffle between all eligible users. At the end of THE Story, the highest ranked 300 users on the Overall Leaderboard will earn a share of the prize pool.
How To Earn Points Description: Earn points by participating in activities and completing challenges outlined in each chapter of THE Story. Actions like staking tokens, referring friends, and completing specific tasks will help you accumulate points. The more points you earn, the higher you climb on the leaderboard, boosting your chances of winning.
How To Earn Fragments Description: Fragments are earned by completing special challenges within THE Story. Collect all fragments to mint an exclusive NFT at the end of your journey. The exact utility of these NFTs will be revealed soon—stay tuned!
How to Claim Rewards Description: If you’ve won, your rewards will be available in the 'Rewards' section of your account. Follow the provided instructions to claim them, which may include a variety of different rewards. Be sure to claim your rewards before they expire.
How Are Winners Selected Description: 用戶只要成功完成指定章節的任務，即可參與該章節專屬的獎勵抽獎活動。THE Story 最終大獎將頒發給總排行前 300 名的參賽者。
How Many Rewards Will Be In Total?: How Many Rewards Will Be In Total?
How Many Rewards Will Be In Total Descri: THE Story offers over $30,000 in rewards, distributed across multiple winners throughout the campaign. Check back regularly for updates on available rewards as each chapter unfolds.

Complete Tasks and Stack Points Descript: Each chapter is packed with exciting tasks. From swaps to referrals, every action earns you points, helping you climb the leaderboard and unlock rewards.
Score Rewards with Every Chapter Descrip: Finish all tasks in a chapter, and you’re in the running for epic prizes. Each chapter has its own raffle, so there's always a fresh chance to win.
Story Leaderboard Description: Earn points and get to the top 300 Thenians on All Chapters leaderboard. For individual chapters you will be eligible to win rewards only if you have completed all tasks for that chapter.
